shortBulletSummary: Binance confirmed a security incident affecting an estimated $6.3 billion in assets ($3 billion frozen), triggering sharp crypto market declines.
Bitcoin fell below $77,000 and Ethereum dropped sharply due to the Binance security scare and broader market sell-offs.
A hawkish Federal Reserve tone and higher PCE inflation data contributed to broader risk-off sentiment in the crypto market.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped to 41 (Fear), reflecting a significant deterioration in investor risk appetite.
